subject: English
question_text: Complete the following passage using suitable connectors:
stimulus: None can deny the importance of tree plantation (a) —— our lives depend on it. (b) —— it is unfortunate that we are cutting trees recklessly. (c) —— trees are planted, soon our land will be deserted (d) —— there will be an adverse situation. (e) —— we should be aware of tree plantation.
guide_solution: Complete the passage with connectors: None can deny the importance of tree plantation (a) because our lives depend on it. (b) But it is unfortunate that we are cutting trees recklessly. (c) Unless trees are planted, soon our land will be deserted (d) and there will be an adverse situation. (e) Therefore, we should be aware of tree plantation.
